jei.kingdomunique.base_costs: Base materials; abilities may reduce costs. The blueprint starts construction.
jei.kingdomunique.obtain.slaughter_blade: Choose Blade of Slaughter if offered in the one-time random relic selection, triggered by having 15 of your registered kingdom citizens within 256 blocks. World-exclusive; also available through the administrator item menu.
jei.kingdomunique.obtain.destruction_pic: Choose Pickaxe of Destruction if offered in the one-time random curse selection on first entering the Nether. World-exclusive; also available through the administrator item menu.
jei.kingdomunique.obtain.admin: Available through the administrator item menu or commands. No crafting recipe is registered.
jei.kingdomunique.obtain.blueprint: See Construction for building material costs. Some blueprints are crafted or purchased from builder citizens; all are available through the administrator item menu.
item.kingdomunique.hades_helmet.effect: Stand still while sneaking for 3s to turn invisible and lose nearby mobs. Attacking or taking damage ends the effect (30s cooldown).
item.kingdomunique.mimir_helmet.effect: Double XP gained and reduce levels spent at enchanting tables and anvils by 30%.
item.kingdomunique.mimir_helmet.acquisit: Obtain by enchanting ten times at level 30 at the same table with 15 active bookshelves.
item.kingdomunique.dragonscale_wingplate: Glide like an elytra while worn. Take 40% less fire and explosion damage.
Obtain by surviving one fall from the Overworld build limit to its bottom bedrock layer.
item.kingdomunique.nemean_lion_hide.effe: Take 35% less melee damage and gain 4 attack damage with an empty main hand.
item.kingdomunique.nemean_lion_hide.acqu: Obtain by defeating a Ravager with a bare-handed hit.
item.kingdomunique.jotun_leggings.effect: While sneaking, take 40% less damage and ignore knockback.
item.kingdomunique.jotun_leggings.acquis: Obtain by unlocking five different ominous vaults in trial chambers.
item.kingdomunique.hermes_talaria.effect: Press jump again in midair to jump once more (3s cooldown). Elytra gliding takes priority.
item.kingdomunique.hermes_talaria.acquis: Obtain by defeating ten phantoms in one night.
item.kingdomunique.salamander_boots.effe: Temporarily solidify lava sources underfoot. Cannot catch fire, but still take direct fire and lava damage.
item.kingdomunique.salamander_boots.acqu: Obtain by riding a strider over lava for a total of 333 blocks.
